title: The Incomplete Conquests
description: Several tribes fail to drive out the original inhabitants of the land. Benjamin allows the Jebusites to remain in Jerusalem, while the house of Joseph takes Bethel with the help of a man who shows them the way inside. Manasseh, Ephraim, Zebulun, Asher, and Naphtali do not drive out the Canaanites but put them to forced labor. The Amorites press the tribe of Dan up into the mountains.
